name: tonecore
description: 一体化音乐中枢 · 音源搜索 / 无损落库 / 自动刮削 / 小爱音箱接入

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.test: npm run build -w apps/server && node apps/server/test/tags.test.mjs && node apps/server/test/player.test.mjs && node apps/server/test/queue.test.mjs && node apps/server/test/scraper-cover.test.mjs && node apps/server/test/cover-extract.test.mjs
